content:
Olivia P.: Heads-up: new draft of the product launch post is ready at https://docs.google.com/draft2. Need copy, hero, and webinar routing approved by EOD Friday. Quick skim appreciated.

Claire M.: Nice draft overall. Two quick asks: 1) Can we add a customer quote placeholder? 2) Make the opening problem statement tighter 1-2 lines.

Raj S.: I'll draft a short customer quote (anonymized) and drop it by noon. For the problem line, what about: 'Shipping LLM features is slow, expensive, and brittle.' short and punchy.

Olivia P.: That works. @Raj S. do 1-2 quote options.

Tara L. (Legal): Reminder: if the quote references customer metrics, need written permission. Also avoid comparative statements like 'Xx faster than Y' unless substantiated.

Raj S.: Understood. I'll keep generic praise and offer to get approval if we want a named case study later.

Emma D.: Design: thinking two hero concepts - 'performance spotlight' (abstract latency graph) and 'human story' (engineer at laptop). Which should be primary? Also will export 1200x630.

Olivia P.: Let's lead with 'performance spotlight' on blog, human story on newsletter. Emma, please export both.

Nate (SEO): Title candidates: 1) "Predictable LLM Serving for Product Teams" 2) "How to Run LLMs with Predictable Latency & Lower Cost" Keep under 60 chars. Also want canonical URL slug. Recommend: /blog/predictable-llm-serving

Claire M.: Good slug. Also suggest meta description: "Reduce inference cost and latency with a production-grade runtime that scales across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." Keep ~150 chars.

Sam G. (Growth): For webinar routing: primary CTA -> webinar register (HubSpot list: 'launch-product-2026'); secondary -> request demo (AE flow). We need hidden fields for role and lead score. Can Marketing Ops add lead scoring tag?

Sophia not in thread, so Sam pasted mapping he wants:
```
hubspot_list: launch-product-2026
form_fields:
 - email -> contact.email
 - full_name -> contact.fullName
 - company -> contact.company
 - role -> contact.jobTitle
 - use_case -> contact.hs_use_case
hidden:
 - campaign -> launch_may_2026
 - source -> blog_post
```
Please confirm.

Olivia P.: Confirmed. Also want UTM mapping: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=launch_may_2026.

Tara L. (Legal): GDPR checkbox required for EU registrants. Suggested copy: 'I consent to receive marketing emails from Redwood Inference. See Privacy Policy.' Link required.

Olivia P.: We'll implement conditional checkbox on country = EU. @publish-bot can the publish workflow check that condition?

publish-bot: Can include conditional UX checks, but publishing scheduler needs final form embed and publish_time param before scheduling.

Raj S.: Quick note on benchmarks: Matt's team uses baseline A (no batching) vs Redwood optimized profile. We should phrase as "measured up to 30% lower token cost in our benchmark harness versus a no-batching baseline; results vary by model and workload." Tara ok?

Tara L. (Legal): That phrasing is safer. Include link to benchmark doc in the copy for transparency.

Claire M.: For CTAs on the blog: Primary button center: "Join the launch webinar" (links to landing); Inline CTAs: "See the benchmarks" (anchor to section) and footer: "Request a demo" (AE routing).

Emma D.: Sending hero files: /design/launch_assets/1766667777_perf.png and _human.png. Alt text drafts: perf: "Abstract latency graph overlaid on stylized server blades"; human: "Engineer reviewing Redwood Console on laptop".

Nate (SEO): Also add structured data: article schema with publish date and author. I'll add after final copy.

Olivia P.: Publishing windows: want to avoid market holidays. Proposed publish_time: 2026-05-11T16:00:00Z (morning PT push). Anyone object?

Sam G. (Growth): That timing works for our lead-gen window. We'll run an email to targeted segments 1 hour after publish.

Tara L. (Legal): I can sign off if final phrasing is in by Thursday 10am PT.

Olivia P.: Plan: I'll update draft with tighter intro + Raj's quotes by Wed EOD. Final copy to legal by Thu 9am. Emma/export by Thu 11am. Nate finalize SEO at Thu 12pm. Sophia or Ops to drop embed by Thu 1pm. Publish-bot will schedule once publish_time param is set.

Claire M.: Minor: byline should credit Marketing + Product. Can we add 'Author: Olivia P., Product Marketing' and a short 2-sentence 'about the author' blur?

Olivia P.: Agree. Will draft byline.

publish-bot: Pre-publish checklist: hero images present; form embed present; legal signoff recorded; publish_time set. Ready status: 2/4.

Olivia P.: Thanks team. I'll post the updated draft link in this thread when done. Ping if you hit blockers. :rocket:
